extraction.teacher_style: Peter and Lauren break down the Shim Sham routine step-by-step with clear counting and positioning. They face away from the camera to make it easy to follow along.

lesson_structure.note: Peter and Lauren introduce themselves and the Shim Sham routine
Demonstrating the basic single-single-double step starting from the left foot with backs to the camera
Adding counts and explaining that steps start on count 8
Teaching the tack annies / tacky ann section

steps_taught.name: Single Single Double
steps_taught.description: Single step left, single step right, and double step

steps_taught.name: The Break
steps_taught.description: Step touch, step touch, and four walking steps back

steps_taught.name: Half Break
steps_taught.description: Step return with kick, cross, and back

steps_taught.name: Tack Annies
steps_taught.description: Stomp off with weight on left foot going right then left

what_works: Clear counting and breakdown of sections

quotes.text: And we're going to teach you a classic swing dance non-partnered routine called the Shim Sham.
So we're going to turn our backs to you so that you can do the routine alongside us.
We're going to do this with counts.
Now we're going to do what's called the break.
